title: Read regression history
responsibility: Show the selected commit’s failing test and its exact passing fix.

inputs.name: regressionHash.bytes
inputs.description: Exact string or Buffer hashed unchanged with createHash('sha256'), used for evidence files, focused captures and canonical record JSON. Any change to these bytes changes the digest, and the signature admits no other types.

inputs.name: regressionHistory.commit
inputs.description: Source commit key whose regression notes are projected; only notes stored under this exact string are read, and a commit with no entries returns an empty array.

inputs.name: regressionHistory.notes
inputs.description: Map from commit to its parsed Git note entries; the selected commit's regression entries are read from it, and a green note's red partner is searched in its origin commit's entries. An origin commit missing from this map gives that note a gap instead of an invented red result.

inputs.name: regressionHistory.load
inputs.description: Loader called for each selected regression note and again for a green note's red partner, returning its record, output and optional files. A rejection from it is caught for that note and becomes its gap, using the error message, or a generic message when the rejection is not an Error.

inputs.name: regressionHistory.media
inputs.description: Defaults to checkedMedia, the named placer imported from ../development-tooling/mediaPlace; it places each verified focused capture's bytes and its resolved fields are merged into that capture. A null or undefined placement result is recorded as media null with the gap 'Focused media is not resolved by this reader.'

inputs.name: sameRegression.red
inputs.description: Red checkpoint that must have phase 'red' and status 'failed'; its command, assertion, profile, inputs, units and tests are the values the green checkpoint must match.

tests: regressionHistory keeps a red commit free of future green results

inputs.name: sameRegression.green
inputs.description: Candidate green checkpoint that must have phase 'green', status 'passed', a source commit different from red's, and a red link naming red's record id and source commit.

tests: regressionHistory keeps a red commit free of future green results

inputs.name: readRegression.note
inputs.description: Pinned regression note whose evidence.path must equal regressions/<commit>/<record> and whose evidence.manifest must equal the SHA-256 of manifest.json. Its commit, record, loop and phase must match the record that readRegression verifies, or readRegression rejects.

inputs.name: readRegression.read
inputs.description: Reader called with the relative paths manifest.json, record.json, output.log and each focused capture path, and each call must return exact Buffer bytes. An undefined result makes that evidence missing, and readRegression rejects.

outputs.name: regressionHash
outputs.description: SHA-256 digest of the input bytes as a 64-character lowercase hexadecimal string.

outputs.name: regressionHistory
outputs.description: Resolved array with one view per selected regression note, in note order; a note whose proof fails becomes a view with units set to [], red set to null and a gap message.

examples.gap: Regression evidence hashes do not match.

outputs.name: sameRegression
outputs.description: True only when red is phase 'red' with status 'failed', green is phase 'green' with status 'passed', their source commits differ, green links to red's record id and commit, and command, assertion, profile, inputs, units and tests all match.

outputs.name: readRegression
outputs.type: Promise<{ record: RegressionRecord; output: string; files: Map<string, Buffer> }>
outputs.description: Resolved object holding the verified record, the output.log text decoded as UTF-8, and a Map of verified focused capture bytes keyed by capture path; any verification failure rejects instead of resolving.

errors.name: Invalid proof
errors.description: readRegression rejects when proof is missing or damaged, and regressionHistory reports a failing Loader call or a failed red pairing as that note's gap view, with red set to null and no green result.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Raised through fail(...) when readRegression finds missing evidence, a wrong evidence path, a manifest or file hash mismatch, a record identity mismatch, a commit, loop or checkpoint mismatch, an output hash mismatch, a phase that does not match the recorded outcome, or a focused capture that is missing, has different bytes, cannot be decoded, or has a different served revision. readRegression itself rejects with it, and regressionHistory does not call readRegression directly.

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.description: Thrown by JSON.parse when the record.json or manifest.json bytes are not valid JSON. readRegression does not catch it, so it rejects with that SyntaxError.

errors.name: regressionRecordSchema.parse error
errors.description: Thrown by regressionRecordSchema.parse when the parsed record.json does not satisfy the regression record schema. readRegression does not catch it, so it rejects with that error.

errors.name: Read callback rejection
errors.description: Any rejection from the read callback passes through readRegression unchanged, because readRegression does not catch errors from its reads.
